situation.zh: 有个人每天早上都和你走同一条路,今天在门口又碰上了。你想问她叫什么名字。
situation.en: Someone walks the same way as you every morning, and you meet her at the gate again today. You want to ask her name.

npc.persona: A woman who walks this way every morning. Warm, glad to be asked.

hit: My name? Mira. And you? Good to know you at last.
Mira. Now we are not strangers. See you tomorrow morning.
partial: Sorry, what would you like to know?
You want to ask me something? Say it again?

slots.zh_hint: 也说出自己的名字(让关系对等)

reference_answer: What is your name? I am Lin.

provenance.rationale: 问名字是从「面熟的人」变成「认识的人」的那一步,也是归属需求里最小、最高频的一次交流。天天见面却互不知名是很常见的状态,而打破它只需要一句话。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 3 层(归属)。name / what / your 属最低频段;「your name?」两个词即算传达到,不要求系动词或语序正确。
